# Fieldnote

> Fieldnote records Zoom, Meet and Teams calls and writes the notes and action items for you. Free for 5 meetings a month.

## Product
- [Home](http://127.0.0.1:8103/): what Fieldnote does and who it is for
- [Pricing](http://127.0.0.1:8103/pricing.html): Free, Team ($12) and Business ($24) plans
- [Docs](http://127.0.0.1:8103/docs.html): set up in 3 minutes
